description: This file defines the AuthenticationSubscriber class which subscribes to specific kernel events within a Symfony-based web application to manage user authentication, session handling, and related security workflows. It handles request validation, controller access, exception handling, and session expiration logic, primarily for the OrangeHRM system's authentication module.

classes.name: AuthenticationSubscriber
classes.description: Handles Symfony kernel events to manage user authentication, session expiration, and security workflows within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Registers the events this subscriber listens to and their corresponding handler methods.

methods.name: onRequestEvent
methods.description: Handles incoming HTTP requests, checking user authentication status.

methods.name: onControllerEvent
methods.description: Executes logic during controller invocation, such as session validity checks, user status validation, and redirects or exceptions as needed.

methods.name: onExceptionEvent
methods.description: Handles exceptions thrown during kernel processing, such as session expiration or unauthorized access, and redirects or responds accordingly.

methods.name: getControllerInstance
methods.description: Retrieves the controller object from the event.

methods.name: getSystemUser
methods.description: Fetches the current system user entity based on the authenticated user ID.

methods.name: isLoggedInUserActive
methods.description: Checks if the user account is active and not deleted.

methods.name: resolveAuthenticatedUserException
methods.description: Determines if there are any issues with the authenticated user, such as disabled status or termination.

methods.name: hasUserLastModifiedChanged
methods.description: Checks if the user's last modified timestamp has changed, indicating potential session invalidation.

methods.name: refreshUserLastModified
methods.description: Updates the stored last modified timestamp for the user in the session.

methods.name: getUserLastModifiedValue
methods.description: Retrieves the last modified timestamp of a user as a string.

methods.name: logoutCurrentSession
methods.description: Invalidates current user session and adds a flash message indicating authentication failure.
